notes: "what ... for?" correctly routes to the purpose-only (PurposeOf $g <focus>) conjunct, "use" correctly takes Theme, the agentless passive correctly omits Agent, and the present habitual correctly carries no status atom. Worth knowing downstream: the seeded PurposeOf bridge comes only from the purpose connective heads (To / InOrderTo / SoAsTo), so a purpose stated as a noun-attached (For ...) oblique would not bind this query.
